body.label: Effect
body.html: On a success, deal 1 weapon damage and it cannot gain Defense from Reactions against your next Prowess Action this turn.

surges.html: Gain +1 Defense against the target until your next turn.
Your next Prowess Action against the target this turn ignores 1 Defense.

rider.title: OPENER
rider.html: If you began this Action with no Combo and deal damage, your next Prowess Action against the target this turn may commit 1 fewer die, minimum 2.
